由 $z+e^z=xy$ 和 $z+e^z-xy=0$，由隐函数求导公式可得

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_x'}{F_z'}=\frac{y}{1+e^z},\qquad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_y'}{F_z'}=\frac{x}{1+e^z}
$$

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_x'}{F_z'}=\frac{y}{1+e^z},\qquad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_y'}{F_z'}=\frac{x}{1+e^z}
$$
